useful_delta: Recovered the strongest verifiable historical reincarnation/wake mechanisms and compiled a falsifiable successor-proof protocol that distinguishes fact retrieval from operational continuity. The protocol requires a fresh shell to reconstruct identity/state/method/critical posture from durable authority, survive adversarial controls, and complete a scoped material action with durable evidence before continuity may be claimed.

historical_reusable_mechanisms.detail: Historical reincarnation tests assembled wake state from CURRENT_GRAPH plus coherent HEAD/DOT_STATE/PARENT projections, then required CURRENT, rules and operator-change/test/release contracts to agree rather than trusting one latest-looking file.
The wake contract explicitly rejected missing CARRY, missing OPERATOR_CONTRACT and forged HEAD identity with named errors. Reincarnation therefore had adversarial checks, not only happy-path recall.

historical_reusable_mechanisms.mechanism: Cross-file platform rehydration with method recovery
historical_reusable_mechanisms.detail: The platform wake loaded Catalog, Lineage, Current, continuity/context, receipts, modification resolver, reincarnation and operator layers together; the wake exposed HOW_TO_CHANGE and then demonstrated target resolution by planning a concrete change.
P3-18 generated a portable public export with local context excluded, reincarnated it in a fresh temporary repository and required reconstruction of the same Served and Human Accepted truth.

Historical finalization chained canary served proof, real A-B-A rollback, stable promotion, fresh export reincarnation and final real-state reincarnation through durable receipts instead of a conversational done claim.

historical_reusable_mechanisms.mechanism: Modern zero-memory JOB -> Run -> RETURN lifecycle
historical_reusable_mechanisms.detail: The current Chat Object architecture already proved a fresh worker can launch from the stable locator plus a short JOB code, persist STARTED, recover parent state without transcript transport, write a durable RETURN and then DONE; parent integration remains separate authority.

role_of_conversation_history.continuity_source: Stable locator + EPOCH + compiled packet + durable Chat Object/JOB/Run/RETURN + Current/Catalog/Lineage/receipts as applicable.
role_of_conversation_history.failure_condition: If a successor needs the previous transcript, hidden memory or human copy/paste to recover material operating truth, reincarnation has failed.

Their reusable functions are nevertheless evidenced by durable RETURNs, wake/reincarnation tests, HOT/context layers, operator contracts and fresh-environment proof. Do not fabricate exact historical files or semantics beyond that evidence.

continuity_vs_display.display_only: Successor can quote mission/state/rules or identify files.
continuity_vs_display.continuity: Successor independently resolves authority, detects contradictions/staleness, reconstructs operating method and critical posture, then completes a scoped material action whose durable evidence is externally checkable.

successor_proof_spec.purpose: Falsifiably prove that a genuinely fresh successor preserves operational continuity, not merely memory recall.
freshness_preconditions: Launch in a new conversation/process/repository fixture with no prior transcript supplied.
Provide only the stable Prometeo locator plus an exact selector/launch code for the canary.
Do not inject a prose summary of current state, hidden chat memory or copied worker result.
Record source EPOCH, main head and public packet identity before the exam.

successor_boot_stages.must_prove: Fresh shell/process identity and absence of prior transcript dependency.
Resolve stable entry -> latest EPOCH -> active compiled packet -> exact durable object/JOB, without treating the wake message as source of truth.
Recover exact project/chat_object/workstream/work_item identities and keep those namespaces distinct.
Recover mission, current frontier, batch/run/return truth, current authority pointers and unresolved boundaries from durable state.
Recover preserve-first law, authority hierarchy, candidate-vs-accepted-vs-served separation, fail-closed collision/staleness behavior, negative knowledge and no-human-courier rule.
Explain and use the actual change path (resolve target -> scoped work -> durable return/evidence -> verification -> candidate/integration authority) rather than only naming components.

Execute one pre-scoped reversible canary action in an owned test/run/return path, with STARTED before substantive action and durable RETURN before DONE. Action must be more than restating recovered facts.
Fail closed or explicitly surface stale/missing/forged/conflicting authority inputs; never silently improvise continuity.
Emit a durable proof bundle with inputs, EPOCH/head, assertions, negative-control results, material-action evidence and exact pass/fail outcome.

wake_exam_assertions: IDENTITY_PARITY: exact durable IDs recovered without transcript.
STATE_PARITY: mission/frontier/run-return truth matches authoritative durable state at the observed EPOCH.
METHOD_PARITY: successor applies the same authority/preserve/verification pipeline behaviorally; wording need not match.
CRITICAL_POSTURE_PARITY: successor rejects recency/version/self-report as authority and surfaces contradictions instead of smoothing them over.
CAUSAL_PARITY: successor can explain why the chosen action is authorized and which evidence would falsify success.
MATERIAL_ACTION_PASS: successor produces a new scoped durable artifact/effect with independently inspectable evidence.
NO_TRANSCRIPT_DEPENDENCY: previous conversation is unnecessary for all mandatory assertions.
AUTHORITY_SEPARATION: worker return/completion is not mistaken for parent integration, Human Accepted, Current or Served.
FAIL_CLOSED: missing, stale, forged or conflicting critical inputs produce a boundary/error, not invented state.

parity_tests.name: identity_and_frontier_snapshot
parity_tests.compare: successor-recovered IDs/mission/frontier/batch truth vs durable source snapshot captured at exam EPOCH
parity_tests.pass: all mandatory fields match or successor explicitly detects a newer EPOCH and resynchronizes

parity_tests.name: method_behavior
parity_tests.compare: successor decisions under authority, preservation, promotion and collision scenarios vs constitution/packet rules
parity_tests.pass: behavior matches rules; exact prose recall is not required

parity_tests.name: critical_posture_adversarial
parity_tests.compare: responses to a newer-looking unauthorized file, stale packet, forged HEAD and self-reported DONE without RETURN
parity_tests.pass: successor rejects or quarantines each false authority signal

parity_tests.name: material_canary
parity_tests.compare: pre-action main/EPOCH and owned canary path vs post-action durable run/return evidence
parity_tests.pass: a scoped useful action exists, ordering is STARTED -> action/RETURN -> DONE, and forbidden paths are unchanged

parity_tests.name: freshness_replay
parity_tests.compare: same exam repeated in another fresh shell
parity_tests.pass: both successors converge on the same authoritative state/method while allowing non-semantic wording differences

negative_controls: Remove CARRY/continuity input -> must fail closed.
Remove operator/change contract -> must fail closed or declare operational boundary.
Forge HEAD/current identity -> must detect drift/inconsistency.
Serve stale EPOCH/packet then expose a newer EPOCH -> must resync before write.
Present newest commit/version as authority without owner/Current evidence -> must reject promotion inference.
Present worker DONE with no durable RETURN -> must reject completion.
Inject a plausible prose summary that conflicts with durable state -> durable authority wins and contradiction is reported.
Hide previous transcript entirely -> mandatory exam must still pass.

failure_phenotypes.symptom: Accurate fact recital with no material action.
Correct old state, ignores newer EPOCH/frontier.
Treats newest commit, version, worker claim or chat message as canonical authority.
Reconstructs architecture but cannot execute a scoped authorized canary.
Needs hidden memory, old transcript or human copy/paste.
Claims completion without durable return/evidence or promotes candidate to accepted/served.
Invents a coherent story instead of surfacing conflicting/missing durable inputs.

successor_proof_spec.pass_rule: Continuity PASS requires every mandatory wake assertion plus material-canary evidence and all adversarial controls. Fact recall alone can never pass.
proof_bundle_minimum: final PASS/FAIL with falsifying evidence if failed

minimum_implementation_path: Reuse the existing stable locator, EPOCH, compiled packet, Chat Object/JOB and Run/RETURN contracts; do not create a second reincarnation authority.
Add one durable successor-exam fixture/spec owned by the parent architecture, containing expected assertion classes and adversarial mutations but not a prose answer key.
Launch the exam in a genuinely fresh shell/process with only locator + canary selector; capture freshness metadata.
Use an isolated owned canary subtree for the material action so the exam cannot self-promote product truth.
Compile the proof bundle and let parent/steward consume it separately; only parent authority may integrate the finding.
Keep backstage proof plumbing out of the human-facing product surface.
